prompts.name: library
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. The input is a reference dashboard mockup. Extract and reproduce ONLY the two upright vintage green and brown-red hardcover books in the middle central cell as ONE isolated full-resolution photographic cutout with genuine transparent alpha. Faithfully preserve the selected object's shape, colors, viewing angle, proportions, warm vintage tactile materials and recognizable details from the reference. Crisp natural details like the original object photograph, not blurry or painterly. Remove the green background entirely including gaps. No text, labels, grid, frame, other objects, colored edge spill, halo, glow outside the silhouette, cast shadow plane or backdrop. Soft dimensional shading within the object is fine. Center the entire object group on a square canvas with about 12% transparent margin. Output only the selected object, no dashboard layout.
